html:
SMTO-EXE-0176 — SMTO got an unreadable reply about your document

GUID: a70901e2-14a6-532d-8160-86df34223d6e
Slug: office-invalid-response
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: office

What happened

  • The computer working on your document sent back an answer SMTO couldn't trust or understand. SMTO never overwrites the original document, but check whether a new copy was saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Look in the conversation and the document's folder for a newly saved copy before asking for the change again. SMTO couldn't read the reply, so it doesn't know whether a new file was made.
  2. Open Settings › Setup › Gateways and select Check for updates to see whether the Gateway needs an update. A Gateway on a different version from SMTO can send replies in a form SMTO doesn't expect.
  3. If an update is offered, ask the person who manages SMTO to install it when no tasks are running. Updating restarts the Gateway and stops its running tasks.
  4. Ask SMTO to read the document again, and only repeat your change if no new copy exists. This avoids making the same edit twice.

What success looks like

  • SMTO completes the document task and shows the result without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO and the Gateway. Don't ask SMTO to repeat an edit until you've checked that no new copy was saved.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Office response or cancellation validation rejected the Gateway's reply (office.invalid_response): non-object data, a missing or non-boolean ok/executed/complete fact, an unknown error kind, an oversized envelope, or a success receipt missing required output fields.

What this means

  • Office response or cancellation validation rejected non-object data, invalid boolean facts, oversized envelope or incompatible typed result fields. Office workers treat document content as untrusted data and never execute macros or formulas. Publication creates a separate output under existing File policy; retain revision and effect facts before any new write.

Why this can happen

  • Office response or cancellation validation rejected non-object data, invalid boolean facts, oversized envelope or incompatible typed result fields.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the original operation and expected response contract, preserving any possible output publication.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the response defect and the current source and output state; a mismatched runtime/Gateway version is the usual cause. Confirm versions under Settings › Setup › Gateways and repair a demonstrated incompatibility, but do not update components automatically or replay an uncertain write.
  • Inspect the response defect and current source/output state. Repair a demonstrated compatibility problem; do not automatically update both components or repeat an uncertain write.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect the selected Gateway and update both runtime and Gateway before a new request.

How to verify the fix

  • The original outcome is reconciled and future responses validate under compatible components.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay uncertain writes or execute embedded document content.

Technical notes

  • Office workers treat document content as untrusted data and never execute macros or formulas. Publication creates a separate output under existing File policy; retain revision and effect facts before any new write.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
